confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Nassau's tourist pricing, which runs high for the Caribbean, with 10% VAT and a common 15% service charge on restaurant bills. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately confident. Hostel anchors are least certain because Nassau has few registered hostels, so the dorm and private-room values are bounded guesses. Hotel anchors are sensitive to season and property, and July is a shoulder period. No live listings or booking pages were checked. FX value 0.6955 comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page; the page itself was not opened, so verify it against rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: high-cost English-speaking Caribbean tourist capitals and resort-city pricing, with restaurant and hotel levels calibrated to typical North American island resort pricing. Not based on a named comparable city's verified price list.
